Strategy: If a minimizing unit-speed segment had length L>pi/sqrt(k), take n-1 parallel normal sine test fields on [0,L]; their index forms sum to at most (n-1)(pi squared/L squared-k)L/2<0, contradicting nonnegativity of second variation for a minimizer. Hopf-Rinow makes the closed bounded manifold compact. Sources: Datar §§27.1 and 28.2, pp.199–200, 210–212; Eschenburg §12, pp.59–62.
